notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Arixmethes.
Put the token Arixmethes into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Arixmethes token dies, causing you to draw a card.
The Arixmethes token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
